'''Niande Moorwyn''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Niande Moorwyn}}

== Appearance ==
She is pale-haired and plump, with a sharp nose and inquisitive gray eyes.{{Ref/book|7|36}}

==Abilities==
Niande is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|33}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

== History ==
Niande is 149 years old, she was born in {{ne|851}} and went to the Tower in {{ne|867}}. After thirteen years as [[novice]] and twelve as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|892}}. 

Niande has one [[Warder]].

== Activities ==
She was [[Aes Sedai advisors|advisor]] to King [[Galldrian]] of [[Cairhien]]. During this period she kept a low profile and was known to have visited the country estate of Lady [[Arilyn Dhulaine]] more than once.

She figured out that [[Thom Merrilin]] had killed Galldrian; while she understood why, as Galldrian had had Thom's apprentice [[Dena]] killed, she was displeased with him at all the suffering it had caused Cairhien. To everyone in Cairhien, she seemed to vanish after Galldrian's death. She was later coopted by Cadsuane. 

She is with [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] and [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] in the rebel camp outside [[Cairhien]] when a [[bubble of evil]] erupts forcing them to flee all the while protecting an unconsious [[Rand al'Thor]] who was stabbed by [[Padan Fain]] with the [[Shadar Logoth]] [[Ruby-hilted dagger|dagger]]. When Min told of three sisters being stilled by Rand at Dumai's Wells, Niande and Samitsu vomit over the sides of the carriage they are in.

After it Niande helped Cadsuane to bring Rand safely to the [[Sun Palace]]. She reads while watching over Rand. When Asha'man walk in, she becomes disconcerted and drops her book. 

When Cadsuane left Cairhien to [[Far Madding]], in search of Rand, she left behind Niande along [[Samitsu]] and other [[unaligned sisters]].
